L059: "*FOCUS dataset* MUST have its styles for representing corrections in *dataset artifacts* documented and accessible to practitioners (including whether Replacement, Delta, or Ledger style is used and under which conditions each style applies)."

L060: "*FOCUS dataset* MUST represent a complete snapshot of data for the affected [*delivery scope*](#glossary:delivery-scope) when using [Replacement correction style](#attributes.correctionhandling.overview.correctionstyles.replacementcorrections)."

L061: "*FOCUS dataset* MUST include additive records representing corrections within the same *delivery scope* when using [Delta correction style](#attributes.correctionhandling.overview.correctionstyles.deltacorrections)."

L062: "*FOCUS dataset* MUST include explicit reversal and re-entry additive records representing corrections within the same *delivery scope* when using [Ledger correction style](#attributes.correctionhandling.overview.correctionstyles.ledgercorrections)."

atom.text: CorrectionHandling MUST adhere to the following requirements:

*FOCUS dataset* MUST have its styles for representing corrections in *dataset artifacts* documented and accessible to practitioners (including whether Replacement, Delta, or Ledger style is used and under which conditions each style applies).

*FOCUS dataset* MUST represent a complete snapshot of data for the affected [*delivery scope*](#glossary:delivery-scope) when using [Replacement correction style](#attributes.correctionhandling.overview.correctionstyles.replacementcorrections).

*FOCUS dataset* MUST include additive records representing corrections within the same *delivery scope* when using [Delta correction style](#attributes.correctionhandling.overview.correctionstyles.deltacorrections).

*FOCUS dataset* MUST include explicit reversal and re-entry additive records representing corrections within the same *delivery scope* when using [Ledger correction style](#attributes.correctionhandling.overview.correctionstyles.ledgercorrections).
